description:
The POFACS scheme stands for the Pradhan Mantri OBC Welfare Scheme for the Financial Assistance for Coaching. 

It aims to provide financial assistance to students belonging to the Other Backward Classes for coaching in competitive examinations. 

The objective is to enhance the opportunities for OBC students in securing employment and higher education. 

The benefits include financial support for coaching fees and related expenses for eligible students. 

Eligibility criteria include being a student from the OBC category and having secured admission in a recognized coaching institution. 

The application process involves submitting an online application along with necessary documents to the designated authorities. 

The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. 

The frequency of assistance may vary based on the academic calendar and the specific coaching programs. 

Additional details regarding the scheme can be found on the official government portal.
